answer: Agents bond stake to join an epoch and commit to a polynomial that binds each credential to its rate limit. Semaphore proofs hide identity while RLN nullifiers expose repeated use: duplicate messages in the same epoch yield distinct Shamir shares, allowing recovery of the linked secret and, in this design, its private key. Verification triggers immediate slashing of bonded collateral, making Sybil identities costly. The onyx, canyon, and dune labels are merely illustrative credential names.
